notes: Direct HTTP fetch (no Claude-in-Chrome needed; robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow, only standard PrestaShop private-page rules). Homepage/mega-menu is client-rendered so nav links weren't in the raw HTML; discovery instead used the ES sitemap (https://www.sklum.com/es/img/core/skl/feed/sitemaps/general_sitemap_skl_es.xml, 6970 URLs) filtered for 'navidad' plus the site's own in-page 'related categories' widget (nav#category_list / c-categories-links__item on each Christmas PLP), which was crawled recursively to reach nodes the sitemap omits (packs, cristaleria). Case-insensitive sitemap search for every other holiday vocabulary term (halloween, san-valentin/enamorados, pascua/easter, reyes-magos, black-friday, carnaval, ano-nuevo/nochevieja, dia-del-padre/madre) and for generic season collections (verano, invierno, otono, primavera) returned zero matches -- Sklum ES has no seasonal taxonomy branch besides Christmas ('Navidad'). qty = exact 'js-total-products' counter rendered on each category's own PLP (site's displayed total), not the related-categories widget's data-nproducts attribute, which showed lower/filtered numbers on the same URLs and was rejected as less authoritative per the qty priority order. Excluded as marketing/non-seasonal: /es/11758-comprar-special-price-navidad ('Outlet adornos y decoracion de Navidad' -- clearance/outlet), /es/21620-comprar-special-price-arboles-de-navidad (outlet), /es/23474-comprar-novedades-navidad (New Arrivals). Also considered and excluded /es/12492-comprar-regalos-amigo-invisible ('Secret Santa' gift-exchange gifts, 87 products): the URL/slug carries no 'navidad' branding and it sits inside Sklum's general 'Regalos' (gifts-by-occasion) taxonomy alongside clearly non-seasonal siblings (regalos-kids, regalos-originales, regalos-para-casa-nueva) that are cross-linked from the Christmas-gifts page the same way -- treated as a normal gifts category merely adjacent to Christmas, not a genuine Christmas-branded PLP; flagged for manual review rather than silently included. The 13 rows below form a lattice, not a strict tree -- most nodes are cross-linked from multiple parents (e.g. Christmas Lighting appears under both the root Navidad page and Decoracion de Navidad) and several parent pages (Navidad root, Christmas Table Decor) carry their own product count that is neither zero nor equal to the sum of their linked children, so no artificial is_group parent rows were created; all 13 are emitted as flat Christmas sub-categories with independently verified counts.
